description: Taxonomy and metadata filter recommendation rules for CRUK DataHub

topography_rules.name: Leukaemia and Myeloma Acronyms (Bone Marrow)
topography_rules.rationale: Clinical Rule: Acute/chronic leukaemia acronyms map to C42.1 Bone marrow

topography_rules.name: Leukaemia and Myeloma Terms (Bone Marrow)
topography_rules.pattern: \b(leuk[ae]emia|acute myeloid|acute lymphoblastic|chronic lymphocytic|chronic myeloid|multiple myeloma|myelodysplastic|polycythemia vera|refractory an[ae]mia)\b
topography_rules.rationale: Clinical Rule: Standard leukaemias & myelomas map to C42.1 Bone marrow

topography_rules.name: Colorectal / Bowel

topography_rules.name: Gastro-oesophageal Junction
topography_rules.rationale: Clinical Rule: Gastroesophageal / junctional terms map to C15 Oesophagus, C16 Stomach, and C16.0 Cardia

data_type_rules.rationale: Detected in vivo cellular therapy, adoptive cell transfer, or CAR-T infusion in model organism

data_type_rules.name: Model Organism: Radiotherapies

data_type_rules.name: Patient Study: Quality of Life
data_type_rules.matched_term: Quality of life (eg Education and/or employment)
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected clinical patient demographic measures: health-related quality of life, employment, education

data_type_rules.name: Patient Study: Kidney Function Tests
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected clinical laboratory tests evaluating kidney / renal performance (creatinine, eGFR, BUN)

data_type_rules.name: Patient Study: Liver Function Tests
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected clinical laboratory hepatic panel (ALT, AST, ALP, total bilirubin)

data_type_rules.name: Patient Study: Other Bodily Fluid Analyses
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected clinical fluid cytology or biochemical analysis (CSF, pleural fluid, ascites)

data_type_rules.name: Patient Study: Urine Tests
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected clinical urinalysis, urine cytology, or urinary biomarker testing

data_type_rules.name: Patient Study: Patient-Reported Outcomes
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs, EORTC QLQ, FACIT, SF-36)

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Crystallography
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected macromolecular X-ray crystallography or protein crystal structure technique

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Bioluminescence Imaging
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected optical bioluminescence or luciferase imaging

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Medical Photography
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected clinical medical photography, dermoscopy, or gross pathology photography

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Mechanobiology
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected biophysical mechanobiology, atomic force microscopy (AFM), or stiffness measurement

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Metagenomics
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected metagenomic DNA sequencing (16S rRNA or shotgun metagenomics)

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Other Multi-omic Source
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected atypical multi-omic source (environmental DNA, microbial isolates, or forensic specimens)

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Nanomaterials
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected nanoscale materials, nanoparticles, liposomes, or nanocarrier technologies

data_type_rules.name: Techniques: Spectroscopy
data_type_rules.rationale: Detected analytical spectroscopy, mass spectrometry (LC-MS, MALDI-TOF), or NMR spectroscopy
